title: Teleprompter Pal internal iPhone recording and export checks
ownership_disclosure: The publisher develops Teleprompter Pal. These checks are internal, not independent review.
release_scope: Evidence covers the named development-signed builds only.

capture.method: Opt-in DEBUG physical-device probes with real AVFoundation camera and microphone sessions, isolated script/preferences/take roots. Normal development-signed Release app restored afterward.
capture.interruption: Switched to Settings during actual capture and returned to the same process. Take finalized; recording did not resume automatically.

originals.independent_decode: All three originals decoded, with nonzero audio. Approximately 29.99fps; maximum video timestamp gap35ms.

edit_export.method: Actual iPhone Mirroring interaction with the normal installed app; no DEBUG probe. Existing original retained; temporary derived outputs used.
edit_export.independent_file_check: Files Get Info: MPEG-4,1080x1080,10.3MB; native playback approximately8s. Photos Info:H.264,1080x1080,10.3MB,00:08.
edit_export.restart: Trim, crop, export and destination history persisted.
edit_export.restoration: Returned original to full-length Original crop and verified it reopened.

limitations: Not the same-script test across competitors.
No independent or blinded comparative scoring.
No long-session, all-device, low-storage or thermal reliability claim.
No measured speech-following accuracy, export audio synchronization or speed-to-finished-video comparison.
Current scrolling uses a user-set pace, not voice following.
Private footage, device identifiers, scripts and absolute local paths omitted.
